title: LISTEN: When Do Robot Policies Learn to Listen? (code, pre-registration, per-episode results, paper)
description:
Code, pre-registration, per-episode evaluation records and paper for a controlled, pre-registered study of why language-conditioned robot policies ignore their instructions. Visuomotor imitation policies are trained from scratch in a simulated pick-up task with the data budget, expert, architecture and recipe held fixed; the only variable is the fraction of contrastive scenes, demonstrated with several instructions.

The pre-registration (hypotheses, metrics and analysis plan) is the git commit 39bf011 (tag prereg-39bf011, 2026-11-03), made before any experiment. The repository was published only after the experiments finished, so this timestamp comes from the git history rather than from a public registry, and this archive is a later snapshot. Deviations are logged in PREREGISTRATION.md.
